mapper.select: SELECT p.application_id, p.activity_id, a.title AS activity_title, p.applicant_name, p.phone, p.email, p.gender, p.participation_date, p.status, p.token, p.created_at, p.approved_at, p.cancelled_at FROM application p JOIN activity a ON a.activity_id = p.activity_id WHERE p.token = #{token}

SELECT p.application_id, p.activity_id, a.title AS activity_title, p.applicant_name, p.phone, p.email, p.gender, p.participation_date, p.status, p.token, p.created_at, p.approved_at, p.cancelled_at FROM application p JOIN activity a ON a.activity_id = p.activity_id WHERE p.application_id = #{applicationId}

SELECT p.application_id, p.activity_id, a.title AS activity_title, p.applicant_name, p.phone, p.email, p.gender, p.participation_date, p.status, p.token, p.created_at, p.approved_at, p.cancelled_at FROM application p JOIN activity a ON a.activity_id = p.activity_id WHERE p.activity_id = #{activityId} AND p.status != 'CANCELLED' ORDER BY p.participation_date, p.created_at
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT participation_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM application WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status != 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY participation_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application (activity_id, applicant_name, phone, email, gender, participation_date, token) VALUES (#{activityId}, #{applicantName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{gender}, #{participationDate}, #{token})
mapper.update: UPDATE application SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE token = #{token} AND status != 'CANCELLED'
